source: Neo4j Agent Memory workspace query API

queries.crossConversationPath: MATCH (cb:Conversation)-[h_old:HAS_MESSAGE]->(mb:Message)-[r_old:MENTIONS]->(p:Entity)<-[r_new:MENTIONS]-(ma:Message)<-[h_new:HAS_MESSAGE]-(ca:Conversation) WHERE cb.id = "1679b2a3-2dff-4830-a73d-a009cc7ddafa" AND mb.id = "49f808f7-5389-497f-a4e0-5330cb889cc9" AND p.id = "4227528d-7897-4afb-a02a-c5b88a37e205" AND ma.id = "18230e80-bbbd-47ba-be84-646e221dbd7e" AND ca.id = "794dc0ab-2c26-483d-988e-ea08fbb5ae73" RETURN cb.id AS old_conversation_id, mb.id AS old_message_id, p.id AS pantry_id, p.name AS pantry_name, p.type AS pantry_type, ma.id AS new_message_id, ca.id AS new_conversation_id, mb.content AS old_excerpt, ma.content AS new_excerpt, elementId(h_old) AS old_has_message_edge, elementId(r_old) AS old_mentions_edge, elementId(r_new) AS new_mentions_edge, elementId(h_new) AS new_has_message_edge, keys(h_old) AS old_has_message_keys, keys(r_old) AS old_mentions_keys LIMIT 1
queries.placeMentions: MATCH (old:Entity)<-[a:MENTIONS]-(mb:Message)-[b:MENTIONS]->(p:Entity)<-[d:MENTIONS]-(ma:Message)-[e:MENTIONS]->(new:Entity) WHERE mb.id = "49f808f7-5389-497f-a4e0-5330cb889cc9" AND ma.id = "18230e80-bbbd-47ba-be84-646e221dbd7e" AND p.id = "4227528d-7897-4afb-a02a-c5b88a37e205" AND toLower(old.name) = "brightwater hall" AND toLower(new.name) = "alder branch library" RETURN old.id AS old_place_id, old.name AS old_place, p.id AS pantry_id, new.id AS new_place_id, new.name AS new_place, elementId(a) AS old_place_mention_edge, elementId(b) AS old_pantry_mention_edge, elementId(d) AS new_pantry_mention_edge, elementId(e) AS new_place_mention_edge LIMIT 5
queries.entityTypes: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.id IN ["4271b5c5-0a77-4d60-9620-a0fc1af89cd5", "55eee7c0-e823-4c26-8a30-ec046c16cfea"] RETURN e.id AS id, e.name AS name, e.type AS type
queries.traceNodeCount: MATCH (s) WHERE any(l IN labels(s) WHERE l CONTAINS "Step" OR l CONTAINS "Trace" OR l CONTAINS "Reason" OR l = "ToolCall") RETURN count(s) AS trace_nodes
